originality.rationale: Kerkmann, Cramer and Rothe 2023 expanded primary source, section 4.5, proves that a perfect sum-based EQ partition requires connected components of diameter at most two, and gives a counterexample to converse. Theorem 9 in the SAME section is selfish-first (SF), not equal-treatment (EQ), so it does not imply the asserted threshold. All connected bicliques meet the diameter condition, but their weighted thresholds vary sharply with imbalance. No exact K_(a,b) global EQ threshold identified in inspected sources; hedonic/Nash games use different utilities.
residual_risks: An unindexed exact weighted biclique classification in coalition-game theses may exist; expanded primary source sections inspected, not all related dissertations.
The candidate explicitly extends the original canonical w=n reward to real w>=0; interpretation outside fixed-weight source must remain explicit.

value.rationale: Exact full-family classification resolves a natural unsolved sufficiency question beyond a known diameter-two necessary condition. Shows sharp imbalance sensitivity, explicit witness cut below threshold and equality at boundary; w=a+b is guaranteed. The weighted parameter extension has model motivation as a friend-to-enemy reward ratio, not gratuitous substitution.

limitations: Only K_(a,b), mutual friendships and global sum-based equal-treatment with penalty -1.
No arbitrary friendship graphs, other forms of altruism or Nash/core characterization.
